True def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = w // 2
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    shared = set(x for row in left for x in row) & set(x for row in right for x in row)
    background = min(shared) if shared else 0
    return [[3 if a == b else background for a, b in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(left, right)]
